machine_first_rule: MachineSignal sells decisions and delivery payloads to CRM systems, AI agents, RevOps workflows and software platforms. Human email persuasion is not the primary sales channel.

commercial_ladder.role: Screen many domains cheaply and route records by opportunity score, confidence, commercial strength and next purchase.
Buy a spend-control evidence pack only for records where the score justifies deeper review.
Buy a CRM/workflow action payload only after Deep Analysis confirms the Action Pack gate.

deep_analysis_value.plain_language: Deep Analysis is not a generic report. It tells a customer machine whether buying Action Pack is justified, whether the lead should stay in watchlist or whether spending should stop.
deep_analysis_value.machine_job: Protect customer budget before downstream CRM or agent spend.
deep_analysis_value.action_pack_rule: Buy action_pack only when Deep Analysis confirms sector fit, digital friction, CRM/workflow destination, compliance gate and budget approval.

customer_has_list.question: Which records are worth budget for my declared commercial objective?
machine_flow: buy action_pack only if Deep Analysis confirms the purchase gate

customer_has_no_list.question: Find companies or domains useful for this commercial objective, sector and area.
customer_has_no_list.objective_rule: The commercial objective is mandatory. A generic request such as interesting domains is not enough.
customer_has_no_list.example_objective: Find dentist and odontoiatric clinic domains in Lombardia worth scoring for website-led commercial opportunity and CRM-ready follow-up preparation.
machine_flow: buy deep_analysis only for recommended records
buy action_pack only after Deep Analysis confirms the gate

customer_wants_action.question: Create a CRM/workflow payload for this confirmed opportunity.

recommended_machine_buying_policy.weak: discard or watchlist; do not buy paid add-ons
recommended_machine_buying_policy.medium: nurture, verify or buy Deep Analysis only when recommended
recommended_machine_buying_policy.strong: buy Deep Analysis before Action Pack

current_limits: Beta purchase intents consume credits but do not execute real payments.
External outreach is blocked in beta.
Deep Analysis is a decision and evidence layer, not a guarantee that a target will buy.
Customer machines must apply their own compliance rules before external action.

next_recommended_work.name: partner_materials_and_pricing_update_from_deep_analysis_evidence
next_recommended_work.description: Stop additional live credit-consuming probes and use the persisted Deep Analysis delivery to update partner materials, business plan, P&L, pricing assumptions and machine-facing product copy.
